building_scope_source.role: dataset scope, system type, categories, format, and coverage description

measured_data_precedence: occupant counts and Wi-Fi connected devices
zone temperature, relative humidity, CO2 and indoor-air-quality signals
HVAC state, setpoint, temperature, flow and pressure points

overwriting measured schedules, setpoints, or HVAC runtimes
